title: FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid)
costNote: Always free; never pay to file
deadline: Opens October 1 for the next school year; state deadlines vary
description: The single most important form for paying for college. Filing the FAFSA unlocks federal Pell Grants, work-study, and loans, and many states and colleges use it to award their own aid.

title: CareerOneStop Scholarship Finder
costNote: Free search tool
description: A free, government-run search tool covering thousands of scholarships, fellowships, and grants. A safe alternative to sites that charge fees.

title: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
costNote: Achievement-based college scholarship
description: Achievement-based scholarship for high school seniors who demonstrate leadership, service, and impact in their schools and communities. 150 scholars are selected each year.

title: The Gates Scholarship
costNote: Last-dollar scholarship covering the full cost of attendance
description: Highly selective, last-dollar scholarship for outstanding, Pell-eligible minority high school seniors with significant financial need, covering the full cost of attendance not met by other aid.

title: QuestBridge National College Match
costNote: Full four-year scholarships at partner colleges
description: Connects high-achieving seniors from low-income backgrounds with full four-year scholarships to top colleges and universities through an early-decision-style match.

title: QuestBridge College Prep Scholars
costNote: Free; awards include college admissions support and prizes
description: For high-achieving juniors from low-income backgrounds. Scholars receive college admissions support, invitations to college visits and conferences, and a head start on the National College Match.

title: Jack Kent Cooke College Scholarship
costNote: Large multi-year scholarship plus advising
description: One of the largest undergraduate scholarships in the country, for high-achieving seniors with financial need. Includes college planning support and ongoing advising.

title: Dell Scholars Program
costNote: Scholarship plus a laptop, textbook credits, and support
description: For Pell-eligible seniors who have participated in an approved college readiness program. Values grit and determination over perfect grades, with wraparound support through college.

title: Horatio Alger National Scholarship
costNote: College scholarship for students with critical financial need
deadline: October (for juniors applying ahead of senior year)
description: For students who have overcome significant adversity, have critical financial need, and are involved in community service. Includes national and state-level awards.

title: Ron Brown Scholar Program
costNote: Four-year scholarship plus mentoring
description: For academically talented Black high school seniors who show leadership and a commitment to community service, with lifelong mentoring and networking.

title: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
costNote: Four-year scholarship plus mentoring
description: For minority high school seniors with financial need and leadership potential, combining four years of funding with mentoring, internships, and leadership training.

title: Elks Most Valuable Student Competition
costNote: Hundreds of scholarships awarded each year
description: Seniors are judged on scholarship, leadership, and financial need, starting at the local Elks lodge and advancing to state and national levels.

title: Burger King Scholars
costNote: College scholarships of varying amounts
description: Scholarships for graduating seniors based on GPA, work experience, extracurricular involvement, community service, and financial need.

title: National Merit Scholarship Program
costNote: Enter by taking the PSAT/NMSQT in junior year
deadline: PSAT/NMSQT in October of junior year
description: Students enter by taking the PSAT/NMSQT as juniors. High scorers can become Semifinalists and Finalists, and compete for National Merit and corporate- or college-sponsored scholarships.

title: Hispanic Scholarship Fund
costNote: Merit-based scholarships plus support services
description: Scholarships and support services for students of Hispanic heritage planning to enroll in college full-time, with mentoring and career resources.

title: UNCF Scholarships
costNote: Many scholarships with different criteria
description: UNCF administers hundreds of scholarship programs, many for students attending historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs). Search by eligibility on their site.

title: APIA Scholars
organization: Asian & Pacific Islander American Scholarship Fund
costNote: Scholarships plus leadership programming
description: The nation's largest nonprofit providing college scholarships to Asian American and Pacific Islander students, with priority for those with financial need.

title: American Indian College Fund Scholarships
costNote: Scholarships for Native American and Alaska Native students
description: Scholarships for American Indian and Alaska Native students attending tribal colleges and other accredited institutions, with one application for many awards.

title: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
costNote: Large scholarships for exceptional projects
description: Awards students 18 and under who have completed a significant piece of work in STEM, literature, music, or philosophy that has the potential to benefit society.

title: Coolidge Scholarship
costNote: Full-tuition, merit-based scholarship
description: A full-ride, merit-based scholarship for high school juniors with an interest in public policy, economics, and public service, usable at any accredited U.S. college.

title: Cameron Impact Scholarship
costNote: Four-year, full-tuition merit scholarship
description: Full-tuition scholarship for seniors who show leadership, community service, and impact, along with strong academics.

title: Equitable Excellence Scholarship
costNote: Scholarships for graduating seniors
description: Recognizes seniors who demonstrate ambition, self-drive, and a commitment to making a difference in their communities.

title: Posse Foundation Scholarship
costNote: Full-tuition leadership scholarships at partner colleges
deadline: Nominations by schools and community organizations in the fall of senior year
description: Identifies students with extraordinary leadership potential who may be overlooked by traditional admissions and sends them to top colleges in supportive teams, or posses.

title: Morehead-Cain Scholarship
costNote: Covers all four years at UNC plus summer enrichment
description: The first merit scholarship program in the U.S., covering the full cost of attendance at UNC-Chapel Hill plus funded summer experiences.

title: Robertson Scholars Leadership Program
costNote: Full scholarship plus funded summer experiences
description: Full scholarship for students at Duke or UNC-Chapel Hill with full access to both campuses and three funded summer experiences.

title: Stamps Scholars Program
costNote: Merit scholarships with enrichment funds at partner schools
description: Merit scholarships at dozens of partner universities that typically cover tuition and fees, plus enrichment funds for study abroad, research, or other experiences.

title: VFW Voice of Democracy
costNote: Free to enter; college scholarships for winners
description: Students write and record an audio essay on a patriotic theme, competing at local, state, and national levels for college scholarships.

title: Society of Women Engineers Scholarships
costNote: Many scholarships for future engineers
description: Scholarships for women and gender-diverse students planning to study engineering, computer science, or engineering technology in college.

title: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship
costNote: Scholarship plus a paid internship offer
description: For seniors from underserved and historically underrepresented communities planning to study computer science, including a scholarship and a paid internship at Amazon.

title: Live Más Scholarship
costNote: Passion-based scholarships; no grades or essays required
description: Passion-based scholarship for ages 16-26: applicants submit a short video about their passion and goals instead of transcripts or essays.

title: Boys & Girls Clubs Youth of the Year
costNote: Free for club members; scholarships at state and national levels
description: Club members ages 14-18 are honored for leadership, service, and academic excellence, competing at local, state, regional, and national levels for scholarships.

title: Air Force ROTC High School Scholarship
costNote: Tuition scholarship with a service commitment after graduation
description: Merit-based scholarships that cover college tuition for students who commit to serving as Air Force or Space Force officers after graduation.

title: Upward Bound (TRIO)
costNote: Free; many programs include a small stipend
description: Federally funded program for students from low-income families or who would be first-generation college students, with tutoring, summer programs on college campuses, and help applying to college.

title: College Possible
costNote: Free coaching
description: Free near-peer coaching for students from low-income backgrounds on test prep, college applications, financial aid, and the transition to college.

title: LEDA Scholars Program
organization: Leadership Enterprise for a Diverse America
costNote: Free, including a summer institute
description: Free program for high-achieving juniors from low-income and underrepresented backgrounds, with a summer institute and college admissions advising through senior year.

title: SEO Scholars
location: New York City and San Francisco Bay Area
costNote: Free eight-year program
description: Free eight-year program that starts in 9th grade, providing academic coaching, mentoring, and college and career support for students from low-income families.

title: Free Official SAT and AP Practice
costNote: Free
description: Free official digital SAT practice tests through College Board's Bluebook app and personalized practice on Khan Academy. Fee waivers are available for eligible students.
